description: This file contains implementations of functions related to nested tensors in PyTorch, including constraints checks, linear and matrix multiplication operations, in-place addition, softmax with dropout, and utilities for jagged to dense tensor conversions, specific to nested tensor data structures.

methods.name: void check_nested_tensor_matrix_constraints(const Tensor & nested_tensor,const Tensor & dense_matrix,std::string_view caller)
methods.description: Validates constraints for nested tensor matrix operations ensuring proper dimensions, contiguity, and non-nested status of tensors involved.

methods.name: Tensor nested_linear(const Tensor & input,const Tensor & weight,const std::optional<Tensor> & bias_opt)
methods.description: Performs a linear transformation on a nested tensor input with a given weight and optional bias.

methods.name: Tensor NestedTensor_matmul(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & other)
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication on two nested tensors, returning a nested tensor.

methods.name: Tensor NestedTensor_times_Tensor_plus_Tensor_addmm(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & mat1,const Tensor & mat2,const c10::Scalar & beta,const c10::Scalar & alpha,std::optional<bool> use_gelu)
methods.description: Performs a combined operation akin to a batched addmm on nested tensors, with optional GELU activation.

methods.name: Tensor NestedTensor_add_NestedTensor_in_place(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & other)
methods.description: In-place addition of two nested tensors with matching sizes.

methods.name: Tensor NestedTensor_softmax_dropout(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & query)
methods.description: Computes softmax with dropout on nested tensors, processing each nested tensor individually.

methods.name: Tensor NestedTensor_softmax_dropout_cuda(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & query)
methods.description: CUDA-optimized version of nested tensor softmax with dropout, with additional masking.

methods.name: Tensor NestedTensor_batch_offsets_from_size_tensor(const Tensor & sizes,int64_t extra_elements)
methods.description: Calculates batch offsets from size tensor for nested tensor processing.

methods.name: Tensor NestedTensor_to_mask(const Tensor & nt,std::optional<int64_t> mask_dim,std::optional<int64_t> mask_dim_length)
methods.description: Generates a mask tensor from a nested tensor based on specified mask dimensions.

methods.name: Tensor _jagged_to_padded_dense_forward_cpu(const Tensor & values,TensorList offsets_list,c10::IntArrayRef max_lengths,const double padding_value)
methods.description: Converts jagged (variable-length) tensor data to a padded dense tensor on CPU.

methods.name: Tensor _padded_dense_to_jagged_forward_cpu(const Tensor & padded,TensorList offsets_list,std::optional<int64_t> total_L)
methods.description: Converts a padded dense tensor back into jagged (variable-length) format on CPU.
